title: Gloves · Zeal · attack speed / life / suppression
summary: Maximum Life >= 70; Increased Attack Speed >= 17; Chance to Suppress Spell Damage >= 8. Compare matching modifiers across all gloves bases; profitability unverified.
notes: Slink Gloves is an ordinary evasion crafting base, not a required finished-item identity. Compare the same functional modifier floors across all gloves bases. Do not treat the price of a scarce or premium base as the value of these modifiers.

craft.name: Deafening Essence of Zeal
uncertainties: Starting-base acquisition must use exactly item level 82. Higher item levels can change the affix pool and require a separate cost model.
3.30 affix weights and the full joint stopping condition must be checked in the updated calculator before entering probability, expected executions or base consumption.

Finished-item prices compare all gloves bases with the required modifiers. Defence values, native implicits and premium bases can still change individual prices. Asking prices are not completed sales.

steps.title: Roll the complete item
steps.action: Buy an ordinary uninfluenced, uncorrupted rare Slink Gloves of item level 82; use Deafening Essence of Zeal. The finished-item comparison accepts all gloves bases with the required modifiers. No fracture, metacraft or bench finish is assumed.
steps.continueWhen: All requirements together: Maximum Life >= 70; Increased Attack Speed >= 17; Chance to Suppress Spell Damage >= 8. Stop on this complete result.
steps.failureAction: If any required random modifier is missing, repeat the paid essence on the same base. Each repeat removes all previous non-fractured explicit and crafted modifiers. Stop spending when your budget is exhausted; do not use a safety Annul trick.
